title: Reppastølen, ca. 1905-1910.
blurb: Identifier: SFFf-1988009.288494 Description: Reppastølen mountain farm. The mountains in the background are Skjeldestadåsen, Stedjeåsen og Storehaugen. The milkmaids are Stina Reppen og Sofia Bjørkum. Medium: Glass plate negative. Extent: 13 x 18 cm. Photographer: Nils Olsson Reppen.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.07% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (1.72% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
